title: Lovely Wood Fired Irish Oats Bake
description: A hearty and cozy Irish dish featuring amazake and wood-fired baked oats, perfect for a cold morning. This raw-friendly recipe is baked in a ramekin and features a charred and bouncy texture.
instructions: Preheat the wood fired oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the oats, amazake, almond milk, honey, and unsalted butter until well combined.
Add the vanilla extract and salt to the bowl and stir until the mixture is smooth.
Crack in the eggs and mix until the batter is well combined and creamy.
Pour the mixture into 4 ramekins and place them in the wood fired oven.
Bake for 20 minutes or until the tops are lightly charred and the oats are set.
Remove the ramekins from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the lovely wood fired Irish oats bake warm and enjoy.
Garnish with fresh fruit or whipped cream if desired.
